grammar.summary: 本课学习 no sooner...than 与过去完成时叙事。

points.title: no sooner...than / hardly...when
points.explanation: 刚一……就……：He had no sooner returned than he bought a house. no sooner 后用过去完成时。hardly...when 同义。

examples.en: He had hardly had time to settle down when he sold the house.
examples.cn: 他还没安顿下来就把房子卖了。

points.title: except 表排除
points.explanation: Everything except the weather. except 表"除……之外（不含）"，与 besides（含）相对。

examples.en: He had always wanted to retire in England.
